frpm.business_context: Rows are created annually by the California Department of Education (CDE) when schools submit their CALPADS Fall 1 enrollment and meal eligibility data; each row represents one school's FRPM snapshot for the reporting year.

columns.2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Sta: Indicates whether the school's prior-year (2013-14) CALPADS Fall 1 enrollment data has been certified by the district.
columns.Academic Year: The school year for which the FRPM data is reported.
columns.CDSCode: The unique 14-digit County-District-School (CDS) code that identifies each school in California's education system.
columns.Charter Funding Type: Indicates how a charter school receives its public funding.
columns.Charter School (Y/N): Indicates whether the school is a charter school.
columns.Charter School Number: The unique number assigned by the state to identify a charter school; null for non-charter schools.
columns.County Code: The two-digit numeric code identifying the California county where the school is located.
columns.County Name: The name of the California county where the school is located.
columns.District Code: The numeric code identifying the school district within the county.
columns.District Name: The name of the school district to which the school belongs.
columns.District Type: The administrative classification of the school district.
columns.Educational Option Type: The specific instructional program model or setting offered by the school.
columns.Enrollment (Ages 5-17): The total number of students aged 5 to 17 enrolled at the school, used for Title I funding calculations.
columns.Enrollment (K-12): The total number of students enrolled in grades K-12 at the school.
columns.FRPM Count (Ages 5-17): The number of students aged 5-17 eligible for either free or reduced-price meals.
columns.FRPM Count (K-12): The number of K-12 students eligible for either free or reduced-price meals (FRPM).
columns.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17): The number of students aged 5-17 eligible to receive free meals under the NSLP.
columns.Free Meal Count (K-12): The number of K-12 students eligible to receive free meals under the NSLP.
columns.High Grade: The highest grade level offered at the school.
columns.IRC: Indicates whether the school participates in the Innovative Research and Curriculum (IRC) program; typically a binary flag.
columns.Low Grade: The lowest grade level offered at the school.
columns.NSLP Provision Status: The National School Lunch Program (NSLP) provision type under which the school operates, which affects how meal eligibility is determined.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17): The proportion of enrolled students aged 5-17 who are eligible for free or reduced-price meals, expressed as a decimal.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12): The proportion of K-12 enrolled students who are eligible for free or reduced-price meals, expressed as a decimal.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17): The proportion of enrolled students aged 5-17 who are eligible for free meals, expressed as a decimal.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12): The proportion of K-12 enrolled students who are eligible for free meals, expressed as a decimal.
columns.School Code: The numeric code identifying the individual school within the district.
columns.School Name: The official name of the school.
columns.School Type: The instructional level and program type classification of the school.

frpm.description: This table contains Free or Reduced Price Meal (FRPM) eligibility data for California schools for the 2014-2015 academic year, including enrollment counts, meal program participation, and school classification details. It is used to track student food insecurity and economic disadvantage metrics across public and state-operated schools.

satscores.business_context: Rows are created or updated annually when SAT results are reported to the California Department of Education; a row is generated for each school (rtype=S) or district (rtype=D) that has reportable SAT data for the given year.

columns.AvgScrMath: Average SAT Mathematics section score for test takers; null when the number of test takers is too small to report.
columns.AvgScrRead: Average SAT Critical Reading section score for test takers; null when the number of test takers is too small to report.
columns.AvgScrWrite: Average SAT Writing section score for test takers; null when the number of test takers is too small to report.
columns.NumGE1500: Number of test takers who achieved a combined SAT score of 1500 or higher (out of a maximum 2400 across all three sections); null when the number of test takers is too small to report.
columns.NumTstTakr: Number of 12th-grade students who took the SAT during the reporting period.
columns.cds: County-District-School (CDS) code uniquely identifying the school or district; district-level records use zeros in the school portion of the code.
columns.cname: Name of the California county in which the school or district is located.
columns.dname: Name of the school district to which the school or district record belongs.
columns.enroll12: Total number of students enrolled in 12th grade at the school or district.
columns.rtype: Indicates whether the row represents an aggregate at the school level or the district level.
columns.sname: Name of the school; null for district-level (rtype=D) records.

satscores.description: Contains SAT score statistics for California schools and school districts, including enrollment, test participation, and average section scores. Each row represents either a school-level or district-level aggregation of SAT performance data.

schools.business_context: Rows are created when a new school or educational program is established and assigned a CDS code by the California Department of Education. Rows are updated when administrative details change (e.g., address, leadership, status) and when schools close, merge, or transition to pending status.

columns.AdmEmail1: Email address of the primary school administrator.
columns.AdmEmail2: Email address of the secondary school administrator, if applicable.
columns.AdmEmail3: Email address of the tertiary school administrator, if applicable.
columns.AdmFName1: The first name of the primary school administrator (e.g., principal or director).
columns.AdmFName2: First name of the secondary school administrator, if applicable.
columns.AdmFName3: First name of the tertiary school administrator, if applicable.
columns.AdmLName1: Last name of the primary school administrator (e.g., principal or director).
columns.AdmLName2: Last name of the secondary school administrator, if applicable.
columns.AdmLName3: Last name of the tertiary school administrator, if applicable.
columns.CDSCode: The 14-digit County-District-School (CDS) code that uniquely identifies each school or educational entity in California.
columns.Charter: A flag indicating whether the school operates as a charter school (1 = charter, 0 = non-charter).
columns.CharterNum: The charter number assigned to the school by the authorizing agency, applicable only to charter schools.
columns.City: The city in which the school is physically located.
columns.ClosedDate: The date on which the school officially closed; null if the school is still active.
columns.County: The name of the California county in which the school is physically located.
columns.DOC: A numeric code representing the type of district or administrative body that oversees the school.
columns.DOCType: The human-readable label for the district or administrative body type corresponding to the DOC code.
columns.District: The name of the school district or administrative body to which the school belongs.
columns.EILCode: A short code representing the educational instruction level offered by the school.
columns.EILName: The human-readable label for the educational instruction level corresponding to the EILCode.
columns.EdOpsCode: A short code representing the educational program or operational model of the school.
columns.EdOpsName: The human-readable name of the educational program or operational model corresponding to the EdOpsCode.
columns.Ext: The phone extension associated with the school's primary contact number.
columns.FundingType: The funding model under which a charter school operates.
columns.GSoffered: The range of grade levels offered by the school (e.g., 'K-6', '9-12').
columns.GSserved: The range of grade levels actively served or enrolled at the school, which may differ from grades offered.
columns.LastUpdate: Date when the school's record was most recently updated in the database.
columns.Latitude: The geographic latitude coordinate of the school's physical location.
columns.Longitude: The geographic longitude coordinate of the school's physical location.
columns.Magnet: A flag indicating whether the school operates as a magnet school with a specialized curriculum (1 = magnet, 0 = non-magnet).
columns.MailCity: The city associated with the school's mailing address.
columns.MailState: The U.S. state of the school's mailing address, always California for this dataset.
columns.MailStrAbr: An abbreviated version of the mailing street address using standard postal abbreviations.
columns.MailStreet: The full mailing street address for the school, which may differ from the physical address.
columns.MailZip: The ZIP+4 postal code for the school's mailing address.
columns.NCESDist: The National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) district identifier assigned by the federal government for cross-state reporting.
columns.NCESSchool: The National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) school identifier assigned by the federal government for cross-state reporting.
columns.OpenDate: The date on which the school officially opened or began operations.
columns.Phone: The primary contact phone number for the school.
columns.SOC: A numeric code representing the school's organizational category or type.
columns.SOCType: The human-readable label for the school's organizational category corresponding to the SOC code.
columns.School: The official name of the school or educational program.
columns.State: The U.S. state of the school's physical address, always California for this dataset.
columns.StatusType: The current operational status of the school.
columns.Street: The full physical street address of the school.
columns.StreetAbr: An abbreviated version of the physical street address, using standard postal abbreviations.
columns.Virtual: Indicates the extent to which the school operates as a virtual or online school.
columns.Website: The URL of the school's official website.
columns.Zip: The ZIP+4 postal code for the school's physical address.

schools.description: A comprehensive registry of all California schools, including public K-12 schools, community colleges, adult education centers, and special programs. Each row represents a single educational institution or program location, including both active and historically closed entities.

cards.business_context: Rows are created when new card printings are added to the MTGJSON dataset, typically when new sets are released or when historical card data is catalogued. Rows may be updated when card attributes change (e.g., errata, new marketplace IDs, or availability changes).

columns.artist: The name of the artist who illustrated the card.
columns.asciiName: ASCII-safe version of the card name, used for cards whose names contain non-ASCII characters (e.g., accented or special characters).
columns.availability: Comma-separated list of platforms or formats where this card printing is available.
columns.borderColor: The color of the card's border, which often indicates the era or special treatment of the printing.
columns.cardKingdomFoilId: The product identifier for the foil version of this card on the Card Kingdom marketplace.
columns.cardKingdomId: The product identifier for the non-foil version of this card on the Card Kingdom marketplace.
columns.colorIdentity: Comma-separated color identity of the card using single-letter color codes (W=White, U=Blue, B=Black, R=Red, G=Green), used for Commander deck-building rules.
columns.colorIndicator: The color indicator dot shown on cards that have a color not derived from their mana cost (e.g., transformed or devoid cards).
columns.colors: Comma-separated list of colors of the card using single-letter codes, representing the card's actual colors as defined by its mana cost or color indicator.
columns.convertedManaCost: The total converted mana cost (also called mana value) of the card, representing the sum of all mana symbols in its casting cost.
columns.duelDeck: Indicates which deck of a Duel Decks product this card belongs to.
columns.edhrecRank: The card's popularity ranking on EDHREC, a Commander/EDH deck-building resource, where lower numbers indicate higher usage.
columns.faceConvertedManaCost: The converted mana cost of only the front face of a multi-faced card (e.g., transform or split cards).
columns.faceName: The name of a specific face of a multi-faced card, used when a card has more than one face (e.g., double-faced or adventure cards).
columns.flavorName: An alternate display name for the card used for flavor or thematic purposes, such as on Planeswalker-themed showcase cards.
columns.flavorText: The italicized in-universe flavor text printed on the card, providing lore or thematic context.
columns.frameEffects: Special visual frame treatments applied to the card beyond the standard frame.
columns.frameVersion: The design era of the card frame, corresponding to major frame redesigns in Magic's history.
columns.hand: Hand size modifier for Vanguard cards, indicating the adjustment to the player's maximum hand size.
columns.hasAlternativeDeckLimit: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether the card has a special deck-building rule allowing more than the standard four copies.
columns.hasContentWarning: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether the card has been flagged by Wizards of the Coast for containing potentially offensive content.
columns.hasFoil: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether a foil version of this card printing exists.
columns.hasNonFoil: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether a non-foil version of this card printing exists.
columns.id: Internal surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each card printing record.
columns.isAlternative: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card is an alternative version of another card in the same set (e.g., alternate art or alternate frame).
columns.isFullArt: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether the card uses a full-art treatment where the illustration extends across the entire card face.
columns.isOnlineOnly: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card exists only in digital form and has never been printed physically.
columns.isOversized: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this is an oversized card (larger than standard card dimensions), such as those in Commander precon decks.
columns.isPromo: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card is a promotional printing distributed outside of standard booster packs.
columns.isReprint: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card has been previously printed in an earlier set.
columns.isReserved: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card is on the Reserved List, meaning Wizards of the Coast has committed to never reprinting it.
columns.isStarter: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card was included in a starter or introductory product rather than a standard booster pack.
columns.isStorySpotlight: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card depicts a key moment in the Magic storyline for its set.
columns.isTextless: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this is a special textless promotional version of the card with no rules text printed on it.
columns.isTimeshifted: Boolean flag (1=yes, 0=no) indicating whether this card is a timeshifted reprint, originally used in Time Spiral block with a purple rarity symbol.
columns.keywords: Comma-separated list of official Magic keyword abilities present on the card (e.g., Flying, Haste, Hexproof).
columns.layout: The physical or structural layout type of the card, determining how its faces and text are arranged.
columns.leadershipSkills: A serialized object indicating which Commander/EDH formats this card is legal to use as a commander or oathbreaker.
columns.life: Starting life total modifier for Vanguard cards, indicating the adjustment to the player's starting life total.
columns.loyalty: The starting loyalty counter value printed on Planeswalker cards.
columns.manaCost: The mana cost of the card as printed, using symbolic notation (e.g., {2}{R}{W}{B}) representing the colors and amounts of mana required to cast the card.
columns.mcmId: The unique product identifier for this card on the Magic Card Market (Cardmarket) platform, used for linking to marketplace listings.
columns.mcmMetaId: The meta-product identifier on Magic Card Market (Cardmarket), grouping all printings of the same card across sets under a single reference.
columns.mtgArenaId: The unique identifier for this card in the MTG Arena digital game client.
columns.mtgjsonV4Id: The legacy card identifier from MTGJSON version 4, retained for backward compatibility with older integrations.
columns.mtgoFoilId: The unique identifier for the foil version of this card in the Magic: The Gathering Online (MTGO) digital platform.
columns.mtgoId: The unique identifier for the non-foil version of this card in the Magic: The Gathering Online (MTGO) digital platform.
columns.multiverseId: The unique identifier for this card in Wizards of the Coast's official Gatherer card database.
columns.name: The official English name of the card as printed.
columns.number: The collector number of the card within its set, which may include suffixes (e.g., 's' for starter, 'a'/'b' for double-faced cards) to distinguish variants.
columns.originalReleaseDate: The original release date of the card, used primarily for cards with unique release dates that differ from their set's release date.
columns.originalText: The rules text of the card exactly as it was originally printed, before any errata or oracle text updates were applied.
columns.originalType: The type line of the card exactly as it was originally printed, before any errata or oracle text updates were applied.
columns.otherFaceIds: A comma-separated list of UUIDs referencing the other face(s) of a multi-faced card (e.g., transform, split, or adventure cards).
columns.power: The power value of a creature card as printed, which may be a number or a variable symbol such as '*' for cards with dynamic power.
columns.printings: A comma-separated list of set codes representing every set in which this card has been printed.
columns.promoTypes: A comma-separated list of promotional distribution methods associated with this card printing.
columns.purchaseUrls: A serialized dictionary of affiliate purchase links for this card across marketplaces such as Card Kingdom, Cardmarket, and TCGplayer.
columns.rarity: The rarity tier of the card within its set, which affects how frequently it appears in booster packs.
columns.scryfallId: The unique identifier for this specific card printing in the Scryfall card database.
columns.scryfallIllustrationId: The unique identifier for the card's artwork in the Scryfall database, grouping cards that share the same illustration.
columns.scryfallOracleId: The unique identifier for the card's oracle (canonical rules) definition in Scryfall, shared across all printings of the same card.
columns.setCode: The short alphanumeric code identifying the Magic: The Gathering set in which this printing appears (e.g., 'M21' for Core Set 2021).
columns.side: Indicates which face of a multi-faced card this row represents.
columns.subtypes: A comma-separated list of subtypes appearing after the em dash on the card's type line (e.g., creature subtypes like 'Elf,Scout' or land subtypes like 'Forest').
columns.supertypes: A comma-separated list of supertypes appearing before the main type on the card's type line, indicating special status.
columns.tcgplayerProductId: The unique product identifier for this card on the TCGplayer marketplace, used for linking to purchase listings.
columns.text: The current oracle (canonical) rules text of the card, reflecting any errata issued after the original printing.
columns.toughness: The toughness value of a creature card as printed, which may be a number or a variable symbol such as '*' for cards with dynamic toughness.
columns.type: The full type line of the card as currently defined by oracle rules, including supertypes, types, and subtypes (e.g., 'Basic Land — Forest').
columns.types: A comma-separated list of the card's primary card types (e.g., 'Creature', 'Land', 'Instant'), excluding supertypes and subtypes.
columns.uuid: The globally unique identifier assigned by MTGJSON to this specific card printing, used as the primary key for cross-referencing.
columns.variations: A comma-separated list of UUIDs referencing other printings of the same card within the same set that have different artwork or treatments.
columns.watermark: The name of the watermark symbol printed in the text box of the card, typically representing a faction, guild, or clan affiliation (e.g., 'mardu').

cards.description: The cards table stores detailed information about individual Magic: The Gathering card printings, including physical and digital availability, gameplay attributes, and marketplace identifiers. Each row represents a unique printing of a card within a specific set.

foreign_data.business_context: Rows are created when a card is printed in a non-English language edition, providing translated card text, flavor text, name, and type for players who use non-English versions of the game. Updates may occur when errata or corrections are applied to translated card text.

columns.flavorText: The translated flavor text (thematic, non-mechanical narrative text) printed on the card in the given language, which may be empty if none exists.
columns.id: Unique surrogate primary key identifying each foreign language card record.
columns.language: The language in which this card's data is translated, representing one of the supported non-English print languages.
columns.multiverseid: The Gatherer (Wizards of the Coast's official card database) identifier for this card in the given language, which may be null if the card was not indexed in Gatherer for that language.
columns.name: The translated name of the card as it appears on the printed card in the given language.
columns.text: The translated rules or ability text of the card as printed in the given language, which may be empty for cards with no rules text.
columns.type: The translated type line of the card (e.g., creature type, spell type) as it appears in the given language, which may be empty if unavailable.
columns.uuid: A universally unique identifier linking this foreign language record back to the canonical card record in the main cards table.

foreign_data.description: Stores localized (translated) card data for Magic: The Gathering cards in supported non-English languages. Each row represents a single card's translated attributes for a specific language.

legalities.business_context: Rows are created or updated when a card's legality changes in a given format, typically following official rulings or ban list announcements from the game's publisher. This table is used to enforce deck-building rules and filter card searches by format legality.

columns.format: The Magic: The Gathering play format to which this legality entry applies.
columns.id: Unique surrogate key identifying each card-format legality record.
columns.status: The legality status of the card in the given format, indicating whether it can be freely played, is prohibited, or is limited to one copy per deck.
columns.uuid: Foreign key referencing the unique identifier of the card in the cards table to which this legality entry belongs.

legalities.description: Stores the legality status of individual Magic: The Gathering cards across various competitive and casual play formats. Each row represents a single card-format pairing indicating whether that card is permitted, banned, or restricted in that format.

rulings.business_context: Rows are created when Wizards of the Coast issues a new official ruling to clarify card interactions, resolve ambiguities, or address rules questions; rulings may be updated when game rules change or errata is issued, and are tied to specific card printings via UUID.

columns.date: The official date on which the ruling was issued or last updated by the rules committee.
columns.id: Unique numeric identifier for each individual ruling record.
columns.text: The full text of the official ruling, explaining how the card works in a specific situation or clarifying an interaction with game rules.
columns.uuid: Foreign key referencing the unique identifier of the card in the cards table to which this ruling applies.

rulings.description: Stores official rulings issued by the game's rules committee that clarify how specific Magic: The Gathering cards work in edge cases or complex interactions. Each ruling is linked to a specific card and provides authoritative guidance on card behavior.

set_translations.business_context: Rows are created when a card set is released or localized for a new market, linking a set's code to its official translated name in each supported language. A translation may be null if the set was not officially released or named in that language.

columns.id: Unique identifier for each set translation record.
columns.language: The language into which the set name has been translated, representing one of the officially supported localization markets.
columns.setCode: The short alphanumeric code identifying the Magic: The Gathering card set being translated, corresponding to the set's code in the sets table.
columns.translation: The official translated name of the card set in the specified language; null if no official translation exists for that language.

set_translations.description: Stores localized translations of Magic: The Gathering set names across multiple supported languages. Each row represents a single language translation for a specific card set.

sets.business_context: Rows are created when a new Magic: The Gathering set is catalogued in the MTGJSON data pipeline, typically when a set is announced or released; rows may be updated as set details are finalized (e.g., when isPartialPreview transitions to a complete set).

columns.baseSetSize: The number of cards in the official, numbered base set, excluding variants, promos, and bonus cards.
columns.block: The named block or series grouping that this set belongs to (e.g., 'Return to Ravnica'), null if the set is not part of a block.
columns.booster: A JSON-encoded definition of the booster pack configuration, including card slot contents, sheet compositions, and pack weight probabilities used for pack simulation.
columns.code: The official short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the set (e.g., 'RTR' for Return to Ravnica), used as the primary external reference across MTG platforms.
columns.id: Internal surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each set record in this database.
columns.isFoilOnly: Flag indicating whether all cards in this set are only available in foil treatment.
columns.isForeignOnly: Flag indicating whether this set was released exclusively in non-English languages.
columns.isNonFoilOnly: Flag indicating whether all cards in this set are only available in non-foil treatment.
columns.isOnlineOnly: Flag indicating whether this set exists exclusively on Magic: The Gathering Online (MTGO) or Arena and has no physical print run.
columns.isPartialPreview: Flag indicating whether the set data is incomplete because the full card list has not yet been officially previewed or released.
columns.keyruneCode: The code used to reference this set's symbol icon in the Keyrune font library, which renders MTG set symbols in web and app interfaces.
columns.mcmId: The Magic Card Market (Cardmarket) marketplace numeric identifier for this set, used to link to the set's listing on the European trading platform.
columns.mcmIdExtras: A secondary Magic Card Market (Cardmarket) identifier for supplemental or variant listings of the set (e.g., extras or special editions).
columns.mcmName: The set's display name as it appears on the Magic Card Market (Cardmarket) marketplace, which may differ slightly from the canonical name.
columns.mtgoCode: The set code used on Magic: The Gathering Online (MTGO), which may differ from the standard set code; null if the set is not available on MTGO.
columns.name: The full official display name of the set (e.g., 'Return to Ravnica', 'Magic 2015').
columns.parentCode: The set code of the parent set this set belongs to (e.g., a promo set referencing its main set), null if this is a standalone set.
columns.releaseDate: The official date on which the set was released to the public.
columns.tcgplayerGroupId: The numeric group identifier for this set on the TCGplayer marketplace, used to link to the set's product listings for North American retail pricing.
columns.totalSetSize: The total number of cards in the set including all variants, alternate art, and bonus cards beyond the base numbered set.
columns.type: The product category classifying the nature and purpose of the set.

sets.description: Contains metadata for every Magic: The Gathering card set ever released, including physical, digital, and promotional sets. Each row represents a distinct set with its release details, market identifiers, and product configuration.

badges.business_context: A new row is created whenever a user earns a badge by meeting the criteria for a specific achievement (e.g., receiving a certain number of votes on a question, editing a post, or answering a question that gets upvoted). Badges are not updated once awarded; additional earnings of the same badge type result in new rows.

columns.Date: The timestamp when the badge was awarded to the user.
columns.Id: Unique identifier for each badge award record.
columns.Name: The name of the badge awarded, representing the specific achievement category (e.g., 'Teacher' for posting a well-received answer, 'Editor' for making a first edit, 'Popular Question' for a question reaching a view threshold).
columns.UserId: Foreign key referencing the user who earned the badge, linking to the users table.

badges.description: Records badges awarded to users on the community platform as recognition for specific achievements or contributions. Each row represents a single badge award event for a particular user.

comments.business_context: Rows are created when a community member submits a comment on a question or answer post, typically to ask for clarification, provide brief feedback, or add supplementary information. Comments are generally not edited after creation, though they may be deleted.

columns.CreationDate: The timestamp when the comment was posted to the platform.
columns.Id: Unique identifier for each comment record.
columns.PostId: Foreign key referencing the post (question or answer) that this comment is attached to.
columns.Score: Net upvote count for the comment, reflecting how helpful or relevant other community members found it.
columns.Text: The full textual content of the comment as submitted by the user, which may include markdown or @mentions.
columns.UserDisplayName: Display name of the commenter at the time of posting, populated for anonymous or deleted users where UserId may not resolve to an active account.
columns.UserId: Foreign key referencing the registered user account that authored the comment.

comments.description: Stores user-submitted comments on posts within the codebase community Q&A platform. Each row represents a single comment attached to a specific post, written by a registered or anonymous user.

postHistory.business_context: A new row is created whenever a post is edited, tagged, closed, reopened, locked, or otherwise modified. This provides a complete audit trail of all changes to posts over time, enabling revision diffs and rollback capabilities.

columns.Comment: An optional note describing the reason for the edit or a summary of what changed, sometimes auto-generated (e.g., character count changes) or a social media URL for tweet events.
columns.CreationDate: The timestamp when this history event was recorded, i.e., when the edit or action took place.
columns.Id: Unique identifier for each post history event record.
columns.PostHistoryTypeId: Numeric code indicating the type of action or change that occurred on the post.
columns.PostId: Foreign key referencing the post (question or answer) that this history event belongs to.
columns.RevisionGUID: A globally unique identifier grouping all changes made in the same edit revision (e.g., simultaneous title, body, and tag edits share the same GUID).
columns.Text: The content snapshot associated with this history event, such as the post body text, tag list, or title at the time of the change.
columns.UserDisplayName: The display name of the user who performed the action, used primarily when the user is anonymous or the account has since been deleted.
columns.UserId: Foreign key referencing the user who performed the action; null if the action was performed by an anonymous user or automated system.

postHistory.description: Tracks the full revision history of posts (questions and answers) in the community, recording every change made to a post's content, tags, title, or status. Each row represents a single historical event or edit action applied to a specific post.

postLinks.business_context: Rows are created when a moderator or the system establishes a relationship between two posts, such as marking a question as a duplicate of another or flagging a related question. These links help users navigate between related content and consolidate answers to similar questions.

columns.CreationDate: The date and time when the link between the two posts was established.
columns.Id: Unique identifier for each post link record.
columns.LinkTypeId: Indicates the nature of the relationship between the two posts.
columns.PostId: The ID of the source post that contains or originates the link (e.g., the duplicate question).
columns.RelatedPostId: The ID of the target post being linked to (e.g., the original canonical question).

postLinks.description: Stores directional relationships between posts, capturing when one post is linked to or marked as a duplicate of another. Each row represents a single directed link from a source post to a related post.

posts.business_context: Rows are created when a user submits a question, answer, or other post type. Rows are updated when posts are edited, receive new comments or answers, are closed, become community-owned, or have their scores changed through voting.

columns.AcceptedAnswerId: The Id of the answer post that the question owner has marked as the accepted/best answer (only applicable to questions).
columns.AnswerCount: The total number of answers that have been posted in response to a question; null for non-question post types.
columns.Body: The full HTML-formatted content/body text of the post.
columns.ClosedDate: The timestamp when the post (question) was closed by moderators or community vote; null if the post is still open.
columns.CommentCount: The total number of comments that have been posted on this post.
columns.CommunityOwnedDate: The timestamp when the post was converted to community wiki ownership, allowing broader editing rights; null if not community-owned.
columns.CreaionDate: The timestamp when the post was originally created (note: column name is a typo for 'CreationDate').
columns.FavoriteCount: The number of users who have marked this post as a favorite/bookmark.
columns.LasActivityDate: The timestamp of the most recent activity on the post, such as an edit, new answer, or comment (note: column name is a typo for 'LastActivityDate').
columns.LastEditDate: The timestamp of the most recent edit made to the post.
columns.LastEditorDisplayName: The display name of the last editor, used when the editor is an anonymous or deleted user.
columns.LastEditorUserId: The Id of the registered user who most recently edited the post, referencing the users table.
columns.OwnerDisplayName: The display name of the post owner at the time of posting, used when the owner is an anonymous or deleted user.
columns.OwnerUserId: The Id of the registered user who created the post, referencing the users table.
columns.ParentId: For answer posts, the Id of the parent question post this answer belongs to; null for questions.
columns.PostTypeId: Indicates the type/role of the post within the platform.
columns.Score: The net vote score of the post, calculated as upvotes minus downvotes.
columns.Tags: Angle-bracket-delimited list of topic tags associated with a question (e.g., '<regression><probability>'); only applicable to questions.
columns.Title: The title/subject of the post; only populated for questions (PostTypeId = 1), null for answers and other types.
columns.ViewCount: The total number of times the post (question) has been viewed; null for non-question post types.

posts.description: Stores all posts in the community Q&A platform, including questions, answers, and other post types. Each row represents a single post with its content, metadata, and engagement metrics.

tags.business_context: A new row is created when a tag is introduced to the platform (typically when a user first applies a new tag to a post). The Count is updated as posts are tagged or untagged, and ExcerptPostId/WikiPostId are populated when community members create tag wiki documentation.

columns.Count: The total number of posts currently tagged with this tag, reflecting its popularity and usage frequency.
columns.ExcerptPostId: Foreign key referencing the post that contains the short excerpt (summary) of the tag wiki, providing a brief description of the tag's meaning.
columns.Id: Unique identifier for the tag record.
columns.TagName: The human-readable label for the tag as it appears on posts (e.g., 'regression', 'kernel-density-estimate').
columns.WikiPostId: Foreign key referencing the post that contains the full tag wiki body, providing detailed documentation and guidance on when to use this tag.

tags.description: Stores all tags used to categorize posts in the community platform, along with usage statistics and links to their documentation posts. Each tag represents a topic or concept that users can apply to questions to aid discoverability and organization.

users.business_context: A row is created when a user registers on the platform. It is updated whenever the user logs in (LastAccessDate), gains or loses reputation through community interactions, casts votes, or updates their profile information such as display name, location, or bio.

columns.AboutMe: A free-text biographical section where the user can describe themselves, their interests, or their expertise.
columns.AccountId: The identifier linking this community user account to a global or network-wide account, enabling single sign-on across multiple Stack Exchange-style sites.
columns.Age: The self-reported age of the user in years, as optionally provided in their profile.
columns.CreationDate: The timestamp when the user account was first created on the platform.
columns.DisplayName: The publicly visible username or handle chosen by the user, sometimes auto-generated (e.g., 'user8434') for users who did not set a custom name.
columns.DownVotes: The total number of downvotes this user has cast on posts, questions, or answers across the platform.
columns.Id: The unique internal identifier for the user within this community platform.
columns.LastAccessDate: The timestamp of the user's most recent login or activity on the platform.
columns.Location: The self-reported geographic location of the user, such as a city or country, as entered in their profile.
columns.ProfileImageUrl: The URL of the user's profile avatar image, which may be hosted externally (e.g., via Facebook Graph API) or on the platform itself.
columns.Reputation: The user's reputation score, earned through positive community contributions such as receiving upvotes on posts and answers; new users start at 1.
columns.UpVotes: The total number of upvotes this user has cast on posts, questions, or answers across the platform.
columns.Views: The total number of times this user's profile page has been viewed by other community members.
columns.WebsiteUrl: An optional personal or professional website URL provided by the user in their profile.

users.description: Stores registered user accounts for the codebase community platform, capturing profile information, activity metrics, and reputation scores. Each row represents a unique user who has signed up for the community.

votes.business_context: Rows are created whenever a community member (or the system) performs a voting action on a post, such as upvoting, downvoting, marking as favorite, or offering/awarding a bounty. UserId is null for anonymous or system-generated votes (e.g., community wiki votes), and BountyAmount is only populated for bounty-related vote types.

columns.BountyAmount: The reputation amount associated with a bounty vote; only populated for BountyStart and BountyClose vote types, null otherwise.
columns.CreationDate: The date on which the vote was cast.
columns.Id: Unique identifier for each vote record.
columns.PostId: Foreign key referencing the post that received the vote.
columns.UserId: Foreign key referencing the user who cast the vote; null for anonymous or system-generated votes.
columns.VoteTypeId: Categorizes the type of voting action performed on the post.

votes.description: Records all votes cast on posts within the community platform, capturing upvotes, downvotes, favorites, bounties, and other community-driven voting actions. Each row represents a single vote event tied to a specific post.

customers.business_context: Rows are created when a new customer is onboarded to the debit card program and may be updated if a customer's segment classification or preferred currency changes.

columns.Currency: The primary currency used for the customer's transactions and billing.
columns.CustomerID: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each customer account.
columns.Segment: The commercial market segment the customer belongs to, used to tailor products, pricing, and account management.

customers.description: Stores core profile information for customers enrolled in the debit card specializing program, including their market segment and billing currency. Each row represents a unique customer account.

gasstations.business_context: Rows are created when a new gas station is onboarded into the system and updated if the station changes its chain affiliation or market segment. This table serves as a dimension/lookup table referenced by transaction data to enrich purchases made at fuel retailers.

columns.ChainID: Foreign key referencing the gas station chain or brand that operates this location (e.g., Shell, OMV, MOL).
columns.Country: The country where the gas station is located.
columns.GasStationID: Unique identifier for each individual gas station location.
columns.Segment: The market positioning segment of the gas station, reflecting its pricing strategy and brand tier.

gasstations.description: Contains reference data for individual gas stations, including their chain affiliation, geographic location, and market positioning segment. Each row represents a unique gas station location within the debit card specializing system.

products.business_context: Rows are created when a new product or service category is introduced into the system, and updated when the description of an existing category changes. These records serve as a lookup/reference for categorizing line items on transactions.

columns.Description: A human-readable label describing the product or service category, which may include fuel types, additives, services, or VAT-exempt items such as tyres or breakdown assistance.
columns.ProductID: A unique numeric identifier assigned to each product or service category, used as a foreign key in transaction and sales tables.

products.description: A reference table listing the types of products and services that can be purchased using debit cards at fuel stations or related outlets. Each row represents a distinct product or service category available for transaction.

transactions_1k.business_context: A new row is created each time a customer uses their debit card at a gas station to purchase a product (e.g., fuel or convenience items); rows are typically not updated after creation as they represent immutable point-of-sale events.

columns.Amount: The quantity of the product purchased (e.g., number of liters of fuel or units of an item); a value of 0 may indicate a non-quantity-based or voided transaction.
columns.CardID: Foreign key referencing the specific debit card used to complete the transaction.
columns.CustomerID: Foreign key referencing the customer who made the purchase.
columns.Date: The calendar date on which the transaction took place.
columns.GasStationID: Foreign key referencing the gas station where the transaction occurred.
columns.Price: The total monetary value charged for the transaction in the local currency.
columns.ProductID: Foreign key referencing the product purchased (e.g., a specific fuel grade or convenience store item).
columns.Time: The time of day at which the transaction was processed, stored as a string in HH:MM:SS format.
columns.TransactionID: Unique identifier for each individual purchase transaction.

transactions_1k.description: Records individual purchase transactions made by customers using debit cards at gas stations, capturing details of each fuel or product purchase. The table holds up to approximately 1,000 transaction records.

yearmonth.business_context: Rows are created or updated when monthly transaction data is aggregated for debit card holders, typically at the end of each billing or reporting month, to track consumption trends and support loyalty or spending analysis.

columns.Consumption: The total amount of goods or fuel consumed (likely in currency units or volume units) by the customer during the given month.
columns.CustomerID: Unique identifier for the customer, linking to the customers table.
columns.Date: The year and month of the consumption record, stored as a 6-character string in YYYYMM format (e.g., '201311' represents November 2013).

yearmonth.description: Records monthly fuel or goods consumption amounts for each customer who holds a debit card, aggregated at the year-month level. Each row represents a single customer's total spending/consumption for one calendar month.

Country.business_context: Rows are created once during initial database setup to represent the fixed set of 10 European football nations covered by the dataset; they are rarely if ever updated, as the country list is static for the scope of this database.

columns.id: Unique numeric identifier for the country, used as a foreign key in related tables such as League and Team.
columns.name: The official name of the European country whose football competitions are included in the database.

Country.description: Reference table listing the European countries whose football leagues and teams are tracked in this database. Each row represents one country and serves as a lookup for associating leagues, teams, and matches with their respective nation.

League.business_context: Rows are created when a new league is added to the dataset; they serve as the top-level organizational unit linking countries to their respective league competitions, matches, and team standings.

columns.country_id: Foreign key referencing the Country table, identifying which country this league belongs to.
columns.id: Unique identifier for the league, which also appears to align with the country_id, suggesting a one-to-one mapping between country and league in this dataset.
columns.name: The official name of the league, combining the country name with the league's branded or common name (e.g., sponsor or historical name).

League.description: Contains the professional football leagues covered in the database, each associated with a specific country. Each row represents one top-division league from a European nation.

Match.business_context: Rows are created when a match is scheduled or completed; event XML fields (goal, shoton, shotoff, foulcommit, card, cross, corner, possession) are populated after the match concludes, while betting odds may be recorded before the match. Player lineup and position fields are filled once the starting XI is confirmed.
